headline: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Limited files Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Limited submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition event or change of control requiring public disclosure.
detail: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Limited, a chemical manufacturing company listed on NSE, has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with the stock exchange. This regulation requires disclosure of substantial acquisitions of shares or voting rights that cross specified thresholds (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, 25%, 50%, 75% or 90%). The filing indicates either a new acquirer has breached a threshold or an existing substantial shareholder has increased their stake. The actual acquisition details, acquirer identity, share quantum, and price per share are contained within the filed disclosure document itself, which serves as the primary evidence of the transaction.
